column2: The  Board  may  cancel  the  licence  of  a  licensed

column1: microfinance company on any one or more of the following

column2: failing to commence business within nine months
of the issue of the licence;
failing to satisfy any debt incurred by it, on such
proposing to make or making any composition or
arrangement  with  its  creditors  or  going  into
liquidation  or  being  wound  up  or  otherwise
ceasing to carry on microfinance business;
acting  in  contravention  of  any  provisions  of  this
